intent: A fen warden's courtly gown of pale willow-bark lamellar banded in fen green over bog iron: from the high camera the wide bust tapers to a dark belt and bone sash, then a bone-trimmed bell of a skirt opens wider band by band to its hem.
reason: Bark and bone: the fullest, best-flaring armoured skirt in the run, willow-bark lamellar opening band by band to a bone-trimmed hem; a real battle skirt (5.7, second).
first_fix: Blocks on the shoulders stand out past the shoulder line and make it a broad warrior from above: flatten them, and alternate the muddy brown bands with fen green and straw.
